##### <a name="-zabbix_server--ssl_cert"></a>`ssl_cert`

Data type: `Stdlib::Unixpath`

Absolute path to the TLS certificate file used by the Apache vhost.

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--ssl_key"></a>`ssl_key`

Data type: `Stdlib::Unixpath`

Absolute path to the TLS private key file used by the Apache vhost.

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--db_host"></a>`db_host`

Data type: `Stdlib::Host`

Database host used by the Zabbix server backend.

Default value: `'localhost'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--db_port"></a>`db_port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

Database port used by the Zabbix server backend.

Default value: `3306`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--db_name"></a>`db_name`

Data type: `String`

Name of the MySQL database created for Zabbix.

Default value: `'zabbix'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--db_user"></a>`db_user`

Data type: `String`

Database username granted access to the Zabbix database.

Default value: `'zabbix'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--db_password"></a>`db_password`

Data type: `String`

Database password for `db_user`.

Default value: `'changeme'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--php_timezone"></a>`php_timezone`

Data type: `String`

PHP timezone value written to the frontend configuration.

Default value: `'UTC'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--zabbix_host"></a>`zabbix_host`

Data type: `Stdlib::Host`

Hostname used for Apache virtual hosts and Zabbix API access.

Default value: `$facts['networking']['fqdn']`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--zabbix_port"></a>`zabbix_port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

Port where the Zabbix server listens for trapper and agent data.

Default value: `10051`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--cache_size"></a>`cache_size`

Data type: `String`

Value for the `CacheSize` setting in `zabbix_server.conf`.

Default value: `'8M'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--history_index_cache_size"></a>`history_index_cache_size`

Data type: `String`

Value for the `HistoryIndexCacheSize` setting.

Default value: `'4M'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--trend_cache_size"></a>`trend_cache_size`

Data type: `String`

Value for the `TrendCacheSize` setting.

Default value: `'4M'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--value_cache_size"></a>`value_cache_size`

Data type: `String`

Value for the `ValueCacheSize` setting.

Default value: `'8M'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--log_file"></a>`log_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Absolute path to the Zabbix server log file.

Default value: `'/var/log/zabbix/zabbix_server.log'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--mysql_schema"></a>`mysql_schema`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path to the initial Zabbix MySQL schema archive imported at setup time.

Default value: `'/usr/share/doc/zabbix-sql-scripts/mysql/create.sql.gz'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--charset"></a>`charset`

Data type: `String`

MySQL character set used when creating the Zabbix database.

Default value: `'utf8mb4'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--collate"></a>`collate`

Data type: `String`

MySQL collation used when creating the Zabbix database.

Default value: `'utf8mb4_bin'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--import_cat_cmd"></a>`import_cat_cmd`

Data type: `String`

Command used by `mysql::db` to read compressed schema files.

Default value: `'zcat'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--pollers"></a>`pollers`

Data type: `Integer[1, 1000]`

Number of poller processes (`StartPollers`).

Default value: `5`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--pingers"></a>`pingers`

Data type: `Integer[1, 1000]`

Number of ICMP pinger processes (`StartPingers`).

Default value: `1`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--pollers_unreachable"></a>`pollers_unreachable`

Data type: `Integer[1, 1000]`

Number of unreachable poller processes (`StartPollersUnreachable`).

Default value: `1`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--proxy_pollers"></a>`proxy_pollers`

Data type: `Integer[1, 1000]`

Number of proxy poller processes (`StartProxyPollers`).

Default value: `1`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--trappers"></a>`trappers`

Data type: `Integer[1, 1000]`

Number of trapper processes (`StartTrappers`).

Default value: `5`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--timeout"></a>`timeout`

Data type: `Integer[1, 30]`

Zabbix server processing timeout in seconds.

Default value: `3`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--approot"></a>`approot`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Document root base path used by the Apache virtual host.

Default value: `'/srv/www'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--api_user"></a>`api_user`

Data type: `String`

Username used by the local API bootstrap script.

Default value: `'user'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--api_password"></a>`api_password`

Data type: `String`

Password used by the local API bootstrap script.

Default value: `'password'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--admin_password"></a>`admin_password`

Data type: `String`

Desired Zabbix Admin account password set by the API bootstrap script.

Default value: `'zabbix'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--default_group_ids"></a>`default_group_ids`

Data type: `Integer`

Default host group ID(s) assigned by the API bootstrap script.

Default value: `2`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--default_template_ids"></a>`default_template_ids`

Data type: `Integer`

Default template ID(s) linked by the API bootstrap script.

Default value: `10001`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--icann_nodes_repo"></a>`icann_nodes_repo`

Data type: `Stdlib::Unixpath`

Base path to node data consumed by the host sync script.

Default value: `'/etc/hieradata'`

##### <a name="-zabbix_server--ssl_chain"></a>`ssl_chain`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::Unixpath]`

Optional path to the SSL chain file used by the Apache virtual host.

Default value: `undef`

## Resource types

### <a name="z_host"></a>`z_host`

This type provides the capability to manage hosts in zabbix

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `z_host` type.

##### `ensure`

Valid values: `present`, `absent`

The basic property that the resource should be in.

Default value: `present`

##### `groupids`

Valid values: `%r{\d+}`

groups ids this host is a member of

##### `operational`

Valid values: `true`, `false`

whether to monitor the host

##### `templateids`

Valid values: `%r{\d+}`

groups ids this host is a member of

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `z_host` type.

* [`host`](#-z_host--host)
* [`provider`](#-z_host--provider)

##### <a name="-z_host--host"></a>`host`

Valid values: `%r{[\w\-.]+}`

the FQFN

##### <a name="-z_host--provider"></a>`provider`

The specific backend to use for this `z_host` resource. You will seldom need to specify this --- Puppet will usually
discover the appropriate provider for your platform.
